title: GUM-based uncertainty evaluation of a neural-network RUL estimator on the ZeMA cylinder data set: code, per-cycle results and run logs
description: Supplementary material (code, per-cycle results, run logs, reports and figures) for Sections 5-5.4 of the paper "GUM-Based Uncertainty Evaluation for Neural-Network Measurement Models: A Five-Phase Methodology Applied to Remaining-Useful-Life Estimation" (E. Buchicchio and P. Carbone, submitted to Measurement Science and Technology): remaining-useful-life estimation with a neural network on the ZeMA electromechanical cylinder dataset, with a GUM-based uncertainty budget computed by the law of propagation of uncertainty and by Monte Carlo (JCGM 101). The ZeMA dataset is not included; the scripts download it from Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.5185953).
